variants.name: cottage
variants.prompt: Create ONE isolated medieval HOUSE game sprite on genuinely transparent background, using the attached atlas ONLY as a style reference. Match its late-1990s hand-painted isometric RTS architecture, crisp dark edges, natural material textures, warm upper-left daylight, pale plaster and oak beams, restrained blue door accents. Exact orthographic 2:1 isometric ground axes (diagonals rise one for two across), no perspective vanishing, show front-left entrance facade and right side, upright verticals. Entire roof, chimney and base visible with generous transparent margin. One compact village residential plot. One stone chimney with a clearly visible dark open mouth, NO smoke (animated by game). Small attached details only, no broad landscape, ground slab, people, text, lettering, panels or other buildings. Sharp readable design at small game scale. A SMALL modest single-storey thatched cottage, squat and low, pale cream plaster, thick golden straw roof, uneven exposed oak timbers, one blue front door, two little windows with shutters, stacked logs, a tiny herb pot. Roof covers a compact square footprint. Low chimney on the upper-left roof side.
